lines.trans: Where are we? Smoke and bomb craters are all around.
Crawl forward! We have almost arrived.
We have been crawling through mud for so long!
Tomorrow the final battle awaits us.
Just a little more, just a little bit!
This battle will be the hardest one.
My grandfather was not a traitor!
Everyone knows the truth. Hold on, soldier!
And I want to go home to Russia.
Soon we will return home.
I haven't seen my mother in so long.
Mother is waiting for you alive.
I will not betray my native land!
Then wake up, Ivan! It is time for you.

meanings.note: Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to come back, to return', paired with 'возвращаться'.

meanings.note: Prefix 'во-' ('into, up') marks inward or upward movement (stem 'ронка'). Common feminine noun meaning 'crater, funnel' in everyday Russian.

examples.trans: Smoke and bomb craters.

examples.text: Где мы? Кругом дым и воронки.
examples.trans: Where are we? Smoke and bomb craters are all around.

meanings.note: direction: идти вперёд = to go forward
colloquial, like a preposition + genitive: лезть вперёд кого-то = to push in ahead of someone

examples.trans: Forward! / Let's go!
Go ahead.

meanings.note: Common feminine noun meaning 'mud, dirt' in everyday Russian.

examples.trans: We crawl through the mud.

examples.text: Мы ползём по грязи так долго!
examples.trans: We have been crawling through mud for so long!

давно.gloss: for a long time; long ago

meanings.note: with present: Я давно здесь = I've been here a long time

examples.trans: You haven't been interested in me for a long time.
That was long ago.

examples.text: Вспомнил? Я давно тебя не интересую.
examples.trans: Now you remember? You haven't been interested in me for a long time.

meanings.note: masculine noun that declines like a feminine -а noun

examples.trans: Grandfathers and grandmothers.
My grandpa is kind.

examples.text: Значит, надо глубже копать! Дальние родственники, дедушки и бабушки.
examples.trans: That means we have to dig deeper! Distant relatives, grandfathers and grandmothers.

держаться.gloss: to hold on; to stick with

meanings.note: за + accusative: держись за руку = hold on to my hand

meanings.en: to stick with, keep close to
meanings.note: + genitive: держитесь меня = stick with me

examples.trans: Hang in there!

examples.text: Держитесь меня, и всё будет хорошо.
examples.trans: Stick with me and everything will be fine.

examples.text: Держитесь меня, и всё у вас будет хорошо. Потому что я кто?
examples.trans: Stick with me, and everything will be fine for you. Because who am I?

дойти.gloss: to reach, walk as far as

examples.text: Но они, к сожалению, не дошли до вас.
examples.trans: But unfortunately, it never reached you.

meanings.note: Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.trans: He talks for a long time.

examples.text: А ты иди домой и делай уроки.

meanings.note: Common masculine noun meaning 'smoke' in everyday Russian.

meanings.note: Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('living, alive, live').

meanings.note: Prefix 'за-' marks beginning an action, covering, or stopping by along the way (stem 'втра').

examples.trans: We'll arrange something for tomorrow.

examples.trans: Call me this evening. We'll arrange something for tomorrow.

meanings.note: Prefix 'про-' indicates movement through, completion, or missing the mark (stem 'сыпаться'). meanings.en: dear, darling, my friend (in address: родной мой)

meanings.note: родной брат = full brother; родной город = hometown

meanings.note: forms the superlative: самый главный = the most important

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'коро'). Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

meanings.note: Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('difficult, hard').

examples.text: Детство у меня было трудное. Я вырос в коммуналке.
